item.title: Sterilization Validation for Medical Devices
item.description: Sterilization validation is essential for sterile medical devices. Understanding sterilization methods and validation requirements is crucial for ensuring regulatory compliance.

item.title: Biocompatibility Testing Strategies for Medical Devices
item.description: Biocompatibility assessment, or Biological Evaluation, is a key Essential Requirement for medical device regulatory approval.

item.title: Mastering EU MDR Technical Documentation
item.description: The European Union’s EU MDR (Medical Device Regulation 2017/745) sets strict rules for technical documentation.

item.title: Navigating USFDA’s 510(k) Submission Process
item.description: The 510(k) USFDA premarket notification is the most common pathway for Class II medical devices seeking USFDA clearance.

item.title: Understanding CDSCO’s Medical Devices Rules, 2017
item.description: The Indian MDR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017) set by India’s Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) create a complete regulatory framework for medical devices.
